fact: On 16 October 2025 the Secretary General of the Ministry of National Education presided over the official handover of JIGITUGU equipment, to be integrated into the school report card under the Canadian-funded PASCOFI project in Ségou, Mopti and Bandiagara.
title: Éducation : Lancement de l'application JIGITUGU pour améliorer la scolarisation des filles au Mali
